overview: The paper investigates how reinforcement learning (DPO) versus supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reshapes visual representations in MLLMs, finding that DPO produces stronger and more localized visual features, and proposes PIVOT (Preference-Instructed Vision OpTimization) as an efficient recipe for evolving vision encoders for MLLM use via DPO-based training with an LLM head.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing & Dataset Construction
modules.description: Preprocess and construct training datasets including Stage 1 pre-training data (LAION/CC/SBU-558K, LLaVA-OneVision-3.2M) and Stage 2 post-training data (MPO preference pairs with chosen/rejected responses). Handles data format conversion for image-query-response tuples, image transformation and resolution alignment, preference pair sampling with controlled data scale (3K-40K subsets), and SFT-friendly dataset variants (Under30, NoThink) as well as shifted-distribution dataset construction for distribution-robustness experiments.

modules.name: Custom Data Loader & Sampler
modules.description: Implement custom Dataset and DataLoader classes supporting both SFT format (image, query, chosen response) and DPO/RL format (image, query, chosen response, rejected response). Includes batch collation strategies for paired preference data, random sampling with seed control for reproducibility, and support for varied data scale configurations and distribution-shifted subsets.

modules.name: MLLM Architecture Assembly
modules.description: Assemble the Multimodal LLM by combining a vision encoder (SigLIP2 variants: B/16, L/16, So/16, g/16), a multimodal projector (2-layer MLP), and an LLM backbone (Qwen2.5 variants: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B). Handles model initialization from pretrained weights, vision encoder feature extraction with flexible resolution support, and projector dimensionality alignment between vision and language embedding spaces.

modules.name: SFT Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implement the two-stage SFT training workflow: Stage 1 projector-only alignment followed by full-parameter end-to-end pre-training on VL datasets, and Stage 2 post-training with maximum likelihood objective on chosen responses. Includes epoch management, gradient accumulation, learning rate scheduling, and logging of training metrics.

modules.name: DPO Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implement Direct Preference Optimization as Stage 2 post-training, with the contrastive preference alignment objective that increases chosen response likelihood while decreasing rejected response likelihood relative to a reference policy. Manages the reference model, temperature parameter, and ensures gradient signals propagate to the vision encoder for visual representation refinement.

modules.name: Extended RL Algorithm Implementations
modules.description: Implement additional RL post-training algorithms for comparison: PPO (with reward model and value function), GRPO (group-wise relative ranking with verifiable signals), and MPO (mixed preference optimization combining DPO, SFT, and binary classification losses). Each adapts the same base MLLM architecture with algorithm-specific optimization loops.

modules.name: Vision Encoder Extraction & Standalone Evaluation
modules.description: Extract and detach the vision encoder (and optionally the projector) from a trained MLLM for standalone vision-only evaluation. Supports both encoder-only features and encoder-projector combined features, enabling disentangled analysis of how post-training strategies reshape visual representations independently of the LLM.

modules.name: ImageNet Classification Evaluator
modules.description: Perform linear-probe ImageNet classification evaluation using features from extracted vision encoders. Implements both scikit-learn Logistic Regression with L2 regularization sweep and a prototype-based linear classifier for rapid validation. Evaluates on a random subset for early-stage validation and reports Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy across different model scales and training strategies.

modules.name: Segmentation Probing Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluate object localization capability via segmentation probing on ADE20K dataset. Attaches a two-layer MLP head to frozen vision encoders (trained within MLLMs via SFT or DPO), trains as a patch-level classifier, and measures patch-level macro recall. Supports multiple vision encoder backbones (CLIP, SigLIP1, SigLIP2) and provides qualitative visualization of segmentation maps.

modules.name: Gradient Visualization (Grad-CAM)
modules.description: Implement Grad-CAM visualization for the vision encoder within MLLM post-training. Computes backward-pass gradients of SFT or DPO loss with respect to vision encoder feature activations for specific samples, measures gradient magnitude per token, and generates heatmaps overlaid on input images. Enables analysis of how gradient signals differ between SFT (scattered) and DPO (localized on question-relevant regions).

modules.name: Representation Alignment Metric
modules.description: Compute vision-language representation alignment scores between vision encoders trained within MLLMs and reference LLMs (Gemma, LLaMA-3, Mixtral, Bloomz). Implements the Platonic representation hypothesis metric to quantify representational similarity across modalities, evaluating how training strategy and LLM scale affect alignment quality.

modules.name: PIVOT Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implement the Preference-Instructed Vision OpTimization recipe: attach a vision encoder to an LLM head, perform Stage 1 pre-training (3M instruction-following samples) and Stage 2 DPO post-training (20K preference pairs), then detach the trained vision encoder as PIVOT-enhanced. The resulting encoder is frozen and evaluated by re-integrating into a new MLLM with a fresh LLM and projector, following projector-only pre-training and instruction finetuning on Cambrian-737K or LLaVA-OV-3M.

modules.name: MLLM Benchmark Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Implement evaluation across 16 VQA benchmarks categorized into four domains: General (GQA, SEED, MME, MMBench), Knowledge (AI2D, ScienceQA, MathVista, MMMU), OCR & Chart (TextVQA, DocVQA, ChartQA, OCRBench), and Vision-Centric (MMVP, RealWorldQA, CVBench-2D, CVBench-3D). Aggregates scores per domain and overall, with MME score rescaling for comparability. Supports automated evaluation using lmms-eval integration.

modules.name: Extended Benchmark Evaluation
modules.description: Implement evaluation on extended benchmarks beyond the core 16 VQA suite: hallucination benchmarks (HallusionBench, POPE), captioning benchmarks (MS COCO, DetailCaps-4870 with METEOR/ROUGE-L/BERTScore/CAPTURE metrics), robustness benchmarks (NaturalBench, MME-RealWorld, VL-RewardBench), and text-only benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag, GSM8K) to assess cross-modal and language-only performance retention.

modules.name: Scaling & Ablation Experiment Framework
modules.description: Implement controlled experiment framework for: (1) vision encoder scaling (86M to 1B parameters with fixed LLM), (2) LLM scaling (0.5B to 7B with fixed vision encoder), (3) data scaling (3K to 40K post-training samples), (4) data distribution shift analysis (varying proportions of new-distribution samples), (5) PIVOT ablations (projector reuse configurations: 0/1/2 layers, training data scale, full-parameter vs. frozen-encoder training), and (6) training sensitivity analysis across learning rates.

modules.name: Configuration, Logging & Result Aggregation
modules.description: Implement experiment configuration management via YAML/JSON with inheritance for training stages and model variants; integrate training monitoring with TensorBoard/Wandb for loss curves, learning rates, and benchmark scores; manage model checkpointing (save/load for all training stages); and automate result aggregation into LaTeX tables and performance scaling charts (bar plots for domain comparisons, line plots for scaling trends).
